title: Chana Masala
description: A fragrant, spiced chickpea curry simmered with tomatoes, garlic and ginger.
steps: Blitz the onion, garlic and ginger, then soften in a pan for 8-10 minutes.
Stir in the spices, then add the tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add the chickpeas with their liquid, simmer 10 minutes, then finish with lemon juice and coriander.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food chana masala

notes: A genuinely satisfying vegetarian curry — the long-simmered onion base is what builds the depth of flavor.
